nodes.name: Scrape Website Homepage
nodes.notes: Fetches the website HTML for content extraction

nodes.name: Extract Text from HTML
nodes.notes: Strips HTML tags and extracts clean text content from the website

nodes.name: Claude — Extract Business Knowledge
nodes.notes: Claude extracts structured knowledge: services, prices, FAQs, hours, contact info, policies

nodes.name: Generate Chatbot Embed Code
nodes.notes: Parses knowledge and generates a JavaScript chatbot widget embed code

nodes.name: Save to Knowledge Base Sheet
nodes.notes: Saves extracted business knowledge to the Knowledge Base tab used by the support workflow

parameters.subject: =Your AI Chatbot is Ready — {{ $json.business_name }}
parameters.message:

nodes.name: Email Embed Code to Owner
nodes.notes: Sends the chatbot embed code and installation instructions via email

parameters.message:
=🤖 Your AI chatbot is ready!

✅ Knowledge extracted from {{ $json.website_url }}
📋 {{ $json.knowledge.services?.length || 0 }} services, {{ $json.knowledge.faqs?.length || 0 }} FAQs found

nodes.name: WhatsApp — Chatbot Ready Alert
nodes.notes: Sends WhatsApp notification to owner that chatbot is installed

nodes.name: Weekly Refresh (Sunday 2am)
nodes.notes: Triggers weekly re-scrape of website every Sunday at 2am

nodes.name: Read Current Knowledge Base
nodes.notes: Reads current knowledge to get website URL for re-scraping

nodes.name: Re-scrape Website
nodes.notes: Re-fetches the website for fresh content

meta.description: One-time setup webhook that scrapes the business website, uses Claude to extract services/prices/FAQs/hours/contact info/policies, saves to Knowledge Base Google Sheet, generates a JavaScript chatbot widget embed code, and sends it to the owner. Also includes a weekly Sunday 2am re-scrape to keep knowledge fresh.
